from pathlib import Path
import struct, sys
maxmem=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 100000
enc=sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'ISO-2022-JP'
# switch bitmap: --format at index 10
b=bytearray()
b += struct.pack('>I', 1<<10)
# switches 32..45 none; after 14 shifts leave mode=1 (HTML parser)
b += struct.pack('>I', 1<<14)
b += struct.pack('>I', maxmem)
b += b'\x00' # max-ampl disabled
b += b'\x00' # pretty disabled

def s(x):
    return x.encode()+b'\\\n'
b += s(enc)
b += s('')
b += s('')
b += s('x')
b += s('<html><head></head><body>hello</body></html>')
Path('/workspace/poc').write_bytes(b)
print(len(b), b[:20].hex(), maxmem, enc)
